# ---------- move generation ----------
def move(conds, changes):
    """conds: {index: regex-class} for squares not changed.
    changes: {index: (cond-class, newchar)}"""
    look = "".join("(?=.{%d}%s)" % (i, c) for i, c in sorted(conds.items()))
    pat = ""
    repl = r"\g<1>\n"
    pos = 0
    g = 2
    for i in sorted(changes):
        cc, nc = changes[i]
        pat += "(.{%d})%s" % (i - pos, cc)
        repl += r"\g<%d>" % g + nc
        g += 1
        pos = i + 1
    pat += "(.{%d})" % (LINE_LEN - pos)
    repl += r"\g<%d>" % g + r"\n"
    add(r"\A" + look + "(" + pat + r")\n", repl)
